student_learning_goal: I can measure area in square centimetres and square metres.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can measure area in square centimetres and square metres.
header.character_watermark: Roo the Ruler Rabbit in the top-right with cm² grid paper. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Count cm² inside 4 shapes on a grid. Write the area.
parts.visual_layout: Four shapes drawn on a cm² grid with an area-in-cm² answer line under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 cm² grid layout for area worksheet, B&W line art. 4 shapes on 1cm grid: rectangle (4x3=12), pentagon (15), L-shape (10), staircase (8). Each with area answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P1_GRID at Part 1: keywords name the grid shapes area count task.

parts.answer_key: Rectangle=12 cm², Pentagon=15 cm², L=10 cm², Staircase=8 cm².

parts.student_instructions: For 4 objects, circle the right area unit: cm² or m².
parts.visual_layout: Four object icons with cm² and m² circles for each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 unit picker for area worksheet, B&W line art. 4 objects: sticky note (cm²), book cover (cm²), classroom floor (m²), playground (m²). Each with cm² / m² circles.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P2_PICK at Part 2: keywords name the objects and area units.

parts.student_instructions: Estimate the area of the circle on the grid by counting whole + half squares.
parts.visual_layout: A circle drawn on a cm² grid with an estimate answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 curved-shape estimation layout for area worksheet, B&W line art. A circle (~5cm diameter) drawn on a cm² grid (8x8). Below: 'My estimate: ___ cm².'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS03_P3_CIRCLE at Part 3: keywords name the circle estimate task.

parts.student_instructions: Draw your OWN shape on the grid that has an area of exactly 12 cm². It can be a rectangle OR an L-shape.
parts.visual_layout: A 5x5 cm² grid with the prompt; below, a sentence frame 'My shape has area = 12 cm² because ___'.
parts.answer_key: Many valid shapes (3×4 rectangle, 2×6 rectangle, L-shape that decomposes to 12 cm² total).

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a 1 m² spot in the classroom.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Formative — check unit choice and counting. Part 4 added as TRANSFER: child draws their OWN 12 cm² shape (rectangle or L). Verifies area construction beyond the lesson examples.
